sql: SELECT id, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling FROM (VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30)) AS t(id, v) ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling FROM (VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30)) AS t(id, v) ORDER BY id
